teaches: `wound` is the third sub-type of an affliction and it is this system's, not a book's — a lasting injury written as a document instead of as a note.
`difficulty` on a wound is the check to treat it rather than the check to resist it.
`damage` may be blank: a wound that only costs a DM has no formula to roll.
demo.trap: No Endurance check is ever offered for a `wound`. `MGT2.EnduranceResisted` is exactly `["disease", "poison"]`, so this sub-type is carried, displayed and healed, and never resisted.

system.description: A shoulder that came out of its socket against a mooring line and did not go back the same.
system.effect: DM-2 on any check that puts weight on the arm, until a Medic check of Difficult (10+) closes it.
